lines.text: And while it wallows, the flower runs its oldest trick:
protogyny. The stigmas ripen first, receptive,
hungry for yesterday's pollen on yesterday's beetle.
Only later, hours later, do the stamens loose their dust.
The bowl half-closes overnight. The beetle is a guest
who does not know he is also the courier.
He leaves at dawn dusted gold, carrying the future
to the next lamp burning in the dark.
